description: Found by the cold audit of bedrock-ljh (PR #272). In test/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/persistence_integration_test.exs, the eviction test drives current_version to ~1000 while get_window_edge/1 subtracts the 5s window lag; Version.add/2 raises on the underflow so advance_window/2 always returns {:no_eviction, _}, the {:evict, ...} branch never runs, and the two closing assertions are trivially true. Rewrite the test so versions start above the window lag (e.g. from Version.from_integer(10_000_000)) and assert on the actual evicted set; confirm by breaking eviction and watching the test fail.
title: persistence_integration_test 'window eviction with page data persistence' never evicts: get_window_edge underflows so the evict branch is dead
